question: Kapil Dev lifted the 1983 World Cup (then known as the Prudential Cup '83) in the ______ stadium.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord's**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kapil Dev lifted the 1983 World Cup (then known as the Prudential Cup '83) in the **Lord's Cricket Ground** stadium in London, England.
 
• The 1983 Cricket World Cup, officially known as the **Prudential Cup '83**, was a significant event in the history of cricket 
 
• **The 1983 Cricket World Cup was the third edition of the tournament, held in England from June 9 to June 25, 1983.**
 
• The **tournament featured eight teams: India, West Indies, England, Australia, Pakistan, Sri Lanka, New Zealand, and Canada.**
 
• India was led by **Kapil Dev**, a charismatic all-rounder who played a crucial role in the team's success.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kapil Dev**

 
 
• He is** renowned as one of the greatest all-rounders in cricket history. **
 
• He was known for his **aggressive batting style, exceptional fast bowling, and outstanding fielding skills**
 
• He** captained the Indian cricket team **to its first-ever World Cup victory in 1983
 
• Kapil Dev was the first cricketer to achieve the milestone of **400 Test wickets** and is also known for scoring over **5,000 runs** in Test cricket
 
• He held the record for the highest number of Test wickets until it was broken in 1994.
